summary: 13 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hagipower: add statistics range report builder (4d2a6a0)
  • adventure: add outcome fallbacks from default locale (11d06cd)
  • reports: add HagiPower statistics to battle reports (e84ceb3)
  • plugins: add HagiPower adventures and multi-resolution avatar assets (050a96e)
  • services: enhance Git operations and MonoSpecs management (ef6c0e2)
  • hagipower: add statistics reporting and tracking system (8b59062)

HagiCode-org/web

  • types: add accumulated total balance to Hagipower statistics (053272a)
  • kanban: add adventure plugin visibility filtering (d7f36c3)
  • api: add Hagipower DTOs for battle report (e91a844)
  • i18n: add translations for statistics, session, and status bar (152c682)
  • statistics: add Hagipower statistics report page and drawer (1a78ad6)
  • hero: add avatar series window hook and tests (0643315)
  • project: add MonoSpecs initialization tab (d3cdb87)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • app: remove Tags property from DataAggregationDto (4b88572)
  • claude-helper: add missing JsonPropertyName attribute to ResultMessage (ab35e3d)
